given: a warehouse team member supplies a valid SKU, a warehouse location identifier, a quantity on hand, and a combined tracking code (encoding location, batch, and serial)
when: they submit a request to file the stock level for that SKU at that location
then: a stock record is created and persisted for the given SKU-and-location pair, storing the supplied quantity and tracking code; a subsequent read of that SKU-and-location pair returns exactly that record with all submitted values intact
